'''Veknoids''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that were distinguishable by their large under-bites, sharp [[Tooth|teeth]], slender tails, and fleshy ears that were positioned on the tops of their heads. One famous Veknoid was [[Teemto Pagalies]], a flamboyant [[Podracer]] [[pilot]] from [[Moonus Mandel]]. Pagalies raced in a [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|Podrace]] on the planet [[Tatooine]], but his Podracer was shot down during the race by native [[Tusken Raider]]s.<ref name="DB" /> At least two other Veknoids watched the race from the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena|arena]] grandstands.<ref name="TPM" />
